name: portfolio-expansion
description: A full game year (36 days) of portfolio growth on map v1. The player drops a 500 MW coal block (the MEDIUM rung — 01 §5.1 in 0.24) onto the starting corridor (the existing MV line taps it — 01 §3.3), runs two MV corridors north, connects Turów and Nadmorze, adds a 100 MW coastal wind farm on an LV spur and a 100 MW / 400 MWh battery cycled night-charge / peak-discharge, and buys a second, SMALL coal block (+200 MW) on day 18. Setpoints follow one fixed rule: cover (demand − RES) at the ~92nd percentile of the forecast band (+1.4σ — 02 §5.2) plus 4% for losses, merit order coal → CCGT, re-sent only when the target moves by more than 6% (min. 10 MW). Pins the slow half of the game: revenue climbing turn by turn as the three cities grow (05 §6 — they end the year 12–30% larger), the day-end fixed-cost charge rising with every finished object, the steady dump the forecast margin costs, and the nine turns out of 288 where the band bet loses.
